images.author: Royalbroil
images.caption: The home of Solomon Juneau, the founder of w:Theresa, Wisconsin. It now houses the Theresa Historical Society. It is located on the w:Yellowstone Trail.

facade.faces: street, from below a retaining wall
facade.notes: a two-storey side-gabled frame house (1847) with eyebrow attic windows in the frieze, green shutters, a gabled hood over the side door; it sits high on a terrace above the street behind a tall coursed limestone retaining wall (the town's name is spelled in it) topped by a split-rail fence

why.note: 1840s Greek Revival: a wide frieze with eyebrow windows, low pitch
a street cut through a hill leaves the lot high above it: a retaining wall is the front boundary
